common.cancelledByUser: The privilege request was cancelled; nothing was changed.
common.authorizedOnly: Only scan networks and devices you are authorized to test. Unauthorized scanning can trigger security systems and may be illegal.

help.mask: Subnet mask: defines which part of the IP address identifies the network and which part the device.
help.gateway: Gateway: the router that receives traffic for addresses outside the local network.
help.dns: DNS server: translates domain names to IP addresses.
help.dhcp: DHCP: IP settings are obtained automatically from a server on the network. Static: settings entered manually.
help.sourceIp: The interface and local source IP the operating system picks to reach the target. Learned from the routing table without sending packets.

dashboard.publicIpDisabled: The public IP lookup is turned off in settings.
dashboard.publicIpError: Could not get the public IP: {{error}}

context.splitTunnel: Warning: traffic to the target leaves through "{{target}}" but the public IP lookup leaves through "{{publicIface}}" (split tunnel). The public IP shown may not apply to this target.

portTest.title: TCP port test
portTest.allWarning: Scanning all ports (65,535 ports) may take up to about {{duration}} in the worst case; the time depends on the timeout and concurrency. You can stop the scan at any time. Only open ports are listed in the results.

errors.invalidTarget: Enter a valid IP address or domain name.

config.title: IPv4 and DNS settings
config.privilegeNote: Changes on this page require administrator privileges. You will see what will be done before it is applied; if you don't confirm within 15 seconds after the change, the previous settings are restored automatically.
config.dnsHint: Separate DNS servers with commas (IPv4, up to 4). Leave empty to get DNS automatically (DHCP).
config.conflict: Another device on the network responds at {{ip}}. There may be an IP conflict.

errors.gatewayOutsideSubnet: The gateway is not in the same subnet as this IP and mask.
errors.tooManyDns: At most 4 DNS servers are allowed.
errors.networkOrBroadcast: The IP address cannot be the network or broadcast address.

config.reviewBody: The following change will be made on "{{iface}}". The current settings are backed up first, then the operating system will ask for administrator privileges.
config.rollbackNote: If you don't confirm within 15 seconds after the change, the previous settings are restored automatically.
config.keepBody: If you don't confirm, the previous settings will be restored in {{seconds}} seconds.
config.connectivityOk: Connectivity test passed: the gateway responds.
config.connectivityFail: Connectivity test failed: the gateway is unreachable.

phase.confirmed: The new settings are now permanent.
phase.rolledBack: No confirmation received; the previous settings were restored.

unsupported.networkManagerMissing: Network configuration is only supported on Linux distributions that use NetworkManager. NetworkManager is not running on this system.
unsupported.generic: Network configuration is not supported on this system.

dns.title: DNS server
dns.privilegeNote: Changing DNS needs administrator rights. When you press "Apply", the system permission prompt opens and the selected DNS servers are written to the interface; the IP address does not change. If you do not confirm within 15 seconds, the previous DNS is restored.
dns.mismatch: DNS was written but the value read back is different. Expected: {{expected}} · Read: {{actual}}
dns.rolledBackError: DNS could not be applied; the previous DNS was restored.

phase.rolledBack: Not confirmed; the previous DNS was restored.
phase.failed: DNS could not be changed; the previous setting is kept.

dns.name: Name

errors.invalidSecondary: Enter a valid IPv4 address different from the primary.
errors.duplicate: This primary/secondary DNS pair is already in the list.
errors.tooMany: You can add up to 100 custom entries.

hosts.intro: System hosts file: {{path}}. NetKit only writes its own marked block and never touches lines outside it. A full backup is taken before every write and the DNS cache is flushed.
hosts.invalidEntry: Invalid entry: {{entry}}. Each line must look like "IP domain.name".
hosts.reviewTitle: The hosts file will be changed

review.apply: Entries from enabled groups will be written to the NetKit block in the hosts file. The current file is backed up first, then the operating system will ask for administrator privileges and the DNS cache will be flushed.
review.removeAll: The NetKit block will be removed from the hosts file; lines outside the block stay unchanged. A backup is taken first and administrator privileges are requested.
review.restore: Only the NetKit block from the selected backup is restored; lines outside the block are not changed. The current file is backed up first and administrator privileges are requested.

done.apply: The hosts file was updated and the DNS cache was flushed.

recovery.message: An unfinished network change was found on "{{iface}}". Do you want to return to the previous settings?

settings.publicIpHelp: The only request NetKit makes on its own is the public IP lookup. If you turn it off, the app makes no outside requests at all.

firstRun.title: Before you start
firstRun.body: NetKit can scan ports and change network settings. Only scan networks you are authorized to test; operations that change system settings require administrator privileges and are recorded in a local audit log.
